    - heading "Four units, one circuit." [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Recent reviews describe the skin as a neuro-immuno-endocrine organ built from four units: epidermal, dermal, hypodermal and adnexal (hair follicles and glands). Each holds cells that can make hormones and mount an immune response. They signal to neighbouring cells, through sensory nerves, and through the blood. Most of this picture comes from cell, tissue and animal studies."
